coverage_note: Seven prepared scenario shapes; no product execution, no scope/manifest acceptance, no completed coverage.

cases.title: Compatible rollback to exact retained carrier
cases.purpose: Require actual reactivation/readback, and distinguish a retained-CAS no-op from success.
prerequisites: S1 accepted scope/closure and S3 quota
S2 two independently accepted exact manifests A and B compatible with the same current input/contract set
S5 integrated governed reactivation contract, or execute the existing route as a recorded failing baseline
Governed isolated policy/actor/ratification and real reader process
steps: Publish A through the governed door and record its exact carrier/manifest and ready readback.
Publish distinct B at the same place with accepted bindings, and record ready B.
Attempt exact A through the same governed door, including the exact-retained authored path and promoted claim-receipt path if the candidate uses them.
Read from a separately composed process and record selected manifest, carrier, artifact, result, receipt and projection state.
cases.required_result: A rollback claimed successful must return a ready current read bound to A, with exact compatible closure. Otherwise record a named refusal and preserve B; refusal does not close compatible rollback.
cases.source_inference: The baseline DEDUP route can report emitted:true while retaining B; the promoted receipt path can additionally make the representative/claim receipt inconsistent. NOT REPRODUCED.
cases.planned_regression: The proposed patch regression expects ownership-activation-not-applied for retained A and keeps B unchanged. This fixes truthful refusal only.

cases.title: Incompatible rollback refuses current source/contract bindings
prerequisites: Frozen accepted A and current B/source/input revisions
Exact declared input selected from the S2 closure; prefer a non-anchor input when isolating attachment currentness
Real governed entry point, policy and process reader
steps: Record accepted A's source/recipe/membership/contract bindings and the currently published state.
Change the required input in the isolated source target, preserving the recorded original bytes.
Attempt A through the existing governed door and capture the actual gate/refusal, without historical activation.
Read the current projection and verify no source-incompatible A body is served as current.
cases.required_result: Named refused emit/check outcome with unchanged serving state; current read returns a compatible complete generation or HOLD. ownership-input-changed/unavailable are the current-reader outcomes for corresponding input states; earlier truth refusal must be recorded honestly if it fires first.

cases.title: Published stale generation read as explicit history
prerequisites: S2 accepted generation actually published through the governed door
Declared source drift recorded and active current read observed HOLD
Pinned host/CLI surface preserving raw OwnershipRead fields
steps: Call the actual governed current reader for the published stale generation, retaining its HOLD output.
Call the same real reader with historical:true and a frozen byte limit.
Capture the complete consumed output and check the historical flag and exact manifest/result/receipt references.
Call current read again; do not publish or reactivate the history.
cases.required_result: Historical result ready with historical:true and exact historical binding, while current still refuses stale inputs. All non-currentness checks remain active. Selecting an arbitrary old manifest is not provided by baseline OwnershipQuery.

cases.title: History preserves integrity, review and dependency refusals
prerequisites: S3-R03 exact baseline
Owned isolated target and preserved original bytes
Frozen required closure mutations with object digests
steps: Apply one frozen fault at a time only to owned isolated CAS data; do not directly publish a projection.
Call the real reader with historical:true and retain the full refusal.
Restore only the owned exact original bytes and verify the known-good labelled historical control.
cases.required_result: HOLD with the corresponding real named refusal; historical mode never authorizes missing/forged/blocked/dependency-incompatible knowledge.

cases.title: Local required-object corruption preserves an independent scope
prerequisites: S1 independent scope pair with explicit disjoint required artifact/input closures
S2 accepted and actually published manifests for both scopes
Frozen CAS object file/bytes and root identities from the real disk store
steps: Observe both scopes ready through actual readers.
Corrupt or remove one required CAS object used only by scope A, retaining its exact original bytes and hash.
Read A and B from a separately composed process and retain outputs with manifests and checked closures.
Restore owned bytes and renew only the affected read observations.
cases.required_result: A holds on the damaged required closure. B remains ready with unchanged bindings and body bytes. Navigation to A alone must not create a build dependency. If B shares the corrupted required authority, it is not an independent control.

cases.title: Shared manifest corruption holds all dependent reads
prerequisites: Frozen manifest shared by at least two needed roots and exact dependency mapping
An independently governed valid scope only if it does not depend on the corrupted manifest/authority
Owned isolated target with preserved bytes
steps: Observe ready outputs from every selected root depending on the manifest.
Damage the exact referenced manifest CAS object without replacing its reference or writing a serving projection.
Read each dependent root and the independent control through real readers.
Capture the original, damaged and restored object bytes/digests and responses.
cases.required_result: Each dependent read holds due to the malformed/missing/integrity-invalid manifest; a truly independent scope stays readable. No success inferred from opening some projection.

cases.title: Historical request cannot bypass untrusted-store refusal
prerequisites: S4 actual host provenance classification at a pinned candidate
Owned isolated store and explicit trusted/untrusted controls
S1/S2 scope and generation bindings
steps: Record the trusted labelled historical control.
Exercise the actual host condition that yields tracked-staging or failed read reproof in the isolated target; do not substitute a fake refusal object as host evidence.
Request historical:true at the intended user-facing reader and retain raw output.
Confirm no raw sidecar or low-level CAS read is substituted to satisfy the request.
cases.required_result: The governed reader refuses as ownership-untrusted or the actual corresponding host refusal before returning knowledge; historical mode grants no bypass.

integration_hooks.subject: failed rebuild after source drift and physical sidecar fallback
integration_hooks.oracle: Even if the disk layer opens an earlier readable projection, the current ownership reader must return a compatible complete accepted closure or HOLD; stale old knowledge must not be served as current.
